import json, subprocess, sys
def run(reqs):
    data = ''.join(json.dumps(r)+'\n' for r in reqs)
    r = subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B','/workspace/submission/main.py'], input=data, capture_output=True, text=True)
    return [json.loads(l) for l in r.stdout.splitlines()]

F = lambda fid, path, labels, tmpl='aabbcc1100020500', kinds='KKKDZQTK': dict(id=fid, path=path, template=tmpl, kinds=kinds, labels=labels)
# busy scenario
req = dict(mode='replay', capacities={'s0':2,'s1':2,'r':2},
           flows=[F('f',['s0','s1','r'],[16,16,16]), F('g',['s0','s1','r'],[16,17,18])],
           events=[dict(op='put',flow='f',node=n) for n in ['s0','s1','r']] +
                  [dict(op='enable',flow='f'), dict(op='put',flow='g',node='s0'),
                   dict(op='disable',flow='f'), dict(op='put',flow='g',node='s0'),
                   dict(op='enable',flow='g'), dict(op='put',flow='f',node='s0')])
print(json.dumps(run([req])[0], indent=None))
# full scenario
req2 = dict(mode='replay', capacities={'s0':1,'s1':5,'r':5},
            flows=[F('f',['s0','s1','r'],[16,17,18]), F('g',['s0','s1','r'],[20,21,22])],
            events=[dict(op='put',flow='f',node='s0'), dict(op='put',flow='g',node='s0'),
                    dict(op='put',flow='f',node='s0'), dict(op='put',flow='g',node='s1'),
                    dict(op='enable',flow='f'), dict(op='put',flow='g',node='s1')])
print(json.dumps(run([req2])[0]))
# reset keeps tables
req3 = dict(mode='replay', capacities={'s0':1,'s1':1,'r':1}, flows=[F('f',['s0','s1','r'],[16,17,18])],
            events=[dict(op='put',flow='f',node='s0'), dict(op='put',flow='f',node='s1'),
                    dict(op='put',flow='f',node='r'), dict(op='enable',flow='f'), dict(op='reset'),
                    dict(op='enable',flow='f')])
print(json.dumps(run([req3])[0]))
EOF
